title: The machine monitor already exists; it needs a page you can read

chat.text: Servex's Monitor already samples the machine every 5 seconds: CPU %, free RAM, the top processes, GPU temperature, and CPU temperature if Windows allows it without admin. Agents can read it through system_health. What's missing is the page: one card of icon pills (CPU, RAM, temperatures, process counts, agents) with names on hover, live, each clicking through to its processes. The pill becomes one reusable piece for every class's instance card. Queued after the Servex restart fix. Brief: /framework/ai/2026-10-03/machine-page/
